== References and preview button ==

Thanks for creating the page for the [[Guild of Illuminators]]!

First, though, could you please use the "Preview" button in the future. This lets you see what your changes would look like without saving it. It also cuts down on the entries in the [[Special:RecentChanges]] listing.

Second, there is a simplified way of doing the reference section. Instead of adding the coding that you did, use the {{tl|notes}} template. It adds all of that automatically. Also, instead of using the book initial tempaltes for references, we use the numbers. So use <nowiki>{{ref/book|6|31}} instead of {{ref/book|LOC|31}}</nowiki>. This displays the reference link to both the book and chapter pages.

Please let me know if you have any questions. Thanks again for adding that page! ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 00:26, January 15, 2011 (UTC)

:Thanks for the tips, I'll follow that format. I'm still learning the ropes around here. :) --[[User:JackEriksson|JackEriksson]] 07:54, January 16, 2011 (UTC)
